parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file passes: BorrowBookUseCase does what an application-layer use case should. Its execute method looks up the book and member through the domain repository interfaces and throws not-found errors if either is missing. It hands the borrowing-eligibility check to the domain service LoanPolicy.assertCanBorrow and the state change to the entity method book.checkOut(). It creates the loan with the domain factory Loan.open, saves both through the repository interfaces, and maps the result to an application DTO. It gets time and ID generation through application ports (Clock, IdGenerator), so it has no infrastructure details of its own. It contains no persistence code, HTTP or framework handling, or calculated business rules. One borderline point: the STANDARD_PERIOD constant (21 days) is a business value chosen in the use case rather than in the domain. But it is a single parameter passed to the domain factory, not business logic, so it does not count as a misplaced responsibility. ExecuteContextDto only carries an optional requestId and has no transport logic.
